main_text.p: conficta, aliis supposita, quæ Gratianus si-suppositæ & confictæ quæ in decretum retulerit Gratianus nullius sunt auctoritatis.ne ullo judicio in suum opus corrasit; veluti supposititias illas Epistolas Pseudo-Isidori Mercatoris, quas integras fere descripsit: item Pseudepigrapha quæ affinxit primis urbis Episcopis, quorum omnium accuratissimum & bene longum Catalogum contexuit Doctiss: Blondellus cap. 18. infine fere. Pseudo-Isidori vapulantis, quem vide. Quæ cujus auctoritatis sint, jam satis supra disquisitum est in Pseudo-Isidori collectione.

318. Judicia de Gratiano.Judicia de Gratiano sunt varia. Quidam laudant, quidam taxant & vituperant, quidam ferunt & tolerant. Passim in eum insurgit Anton. Augustin. in libris de ejus Emendatione, qui aliquando totum opus una litura delatum cuperet; aliquando iterum paucis excusat. Vehementer insurgit Ant. Contius lect. cap. 10. ubi errorum monstra quædam, ut vocat, recenset. Alii vero excusant, alii laudant; Apologeticum ei scripsit ex professo Joh. Chifletius JC. Vesontinus, in Apologetica dissertat. de utriusque jur. Architect. cap. V. Sed qui satis exilis est; In Gratianum debachatur Johannes Molynæus, quem supra Decretum Ivonis edidisse diximus; contra eum amarissime insurgit Boëthius Epo, de jur. facr. qui Gratianum defendit, & Mo-

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right: "suppositæ & confictæ quæ in decretum retulerit Gratianus nullius sunt auctoritatis." and "318. Judicia de Gratiano." Reading of the marginal note words is approximate due to small type. The word "supposita" in the first line was printed with a slightly unusual letter form and is uncertain.
